item.title: Trump and Big AI Go All-In Together
item.description: President Trump and the AI industry have co-signed one of the biggest economic and technological wagers of all time. If it succeeds, it could usher in a new era.

item.title: Rubio ordered Iranian delegation to leave country, U.S. official says
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Monday demanded that the Iranian delegation to the United Nations General Assembly immediately leave the country, according to a U.S. official.

item.title: GOP senators end a difficult week with few results
item.description: Exhausted Republican senators are preparing to return home largely empty-handed after remaining in Washington longer than planned. The midterm outlook remains uncertain.

item.title: How Trump's signature issue faded from voters' attention
item.description: Immigration, the issue that helped propel Donald Trump to the presidency and rally his supporters over the past decade, has become an afterthought for many voters.
